//: Helm charts rendered into templates/generated/inline-manifests/ by `just env=<env> gen-inline-manifests`, then embedded at cluster bootstrap as control-plane inline manifests (name + out). Paths are relative to the bootstrap root. Each chart layers an optional env overlay: <values path minus .yaml>-<env>.yaml (e.g. values-lab.yaml); later files win. Version overrides: HELM_<NAME>_VERSION (name uppercased, dashes → underscores).
